about_the_game:
🦅 Escape the Depths: A Flight Challenge Like No Other

Master flight in a brutal world where patience, precision, and focus are your only tools.
This is a rage-based flying adventure where every movement matters — there are no enemies, no checkpoints, and no second chances. Your sole mission: escape the depths of a treacherous, endless cave and soar to freedom.

Fly using physics-driven controls that reward skill and punish panic.
There are no scripted paths — only towering rocks, deadly spikes, and tangled obstacles daring you to find a way up. Whether skimming walls or threading between giant mushrooms, survival depends entirely on your control of velocity, angle, and space.

Explore a procedurally generated underground world that is beautiful, hostile, and ever-changing.
There’s no map, no perfect route — only an unpredictable, vertical labyrinth that reshapes itself with every fall. Every climb feels different. Every ascent tests your instincts.

This is a game about failing, learning, and trying again.
Some players will spend hours clawing their way upward, while others discover daring shortcuts through the vertical chaos. Every fall is your fault. Every triumph is fully earned.

🛠️ Features:

  • Physics-based flight control — no arcade assists

  • Procedurally generated vertical cave terrain — unpredictable and endless

  • Precision-based traversal through rugged rocks, roots, and giant fungi

  • No checkpoints, no saves — fall and start over

  • One continuous underground world with escalating difficulty

  • A minimalist challenge built around mastery, not mercy

⚠️ This game contains flashing visuals that may trigger seizures for players with photosensitive epilepsy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i5-2500K 3.3GHz / AMD CPU Phenom II X4 940
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 670 or AMD R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel CPU Core i7 3770 3.4 GHz / AMD CPU AMD FX-8350 4 GHz
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD R9 290X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Navigate a chaotic landscape with precision flight. Take control of an eagle in a world that punishes every mistake. Fall often, recover harder. No guidance, no mercy—just instinct, momentum, and the will to rise again.
